column2: [intro]
In the morning, I search for my sock
Spill my coffee, oh what a shock!
I love getting lost in this joyful mess
My house is a museum where nothing is at rest
In my life, it's all chaos
No need to tidy up, it's real, no loss
I live my life, not seeking perfect order
A walking mess, I embrace with no border
My friends shout, "Clean your room, make an effort!"
But I prefer leaving my treasures out of sort
In this joyful clutter, I find my muse
And write songs full of playful cues
Cause I'm the king of chaos
A brain in turmoil, nothing in place, it's a plus
A true artist in my thrilling life
The walking mess, my trademark without strife
[ solo ]
So let me live my life in a messy mode
With my walking mess, I'm always in the right code
I dance among scattered things
Letting wild thoughts bring me blissful flings
[ outro ]
